entities.name: Dryad
entities.description: Spirits of trees taking a nymph-like or treefolk form, found on many planes.

entities.name: Mat'Selesnya
entities.description: Parun of the Selesnya Conclave, formed from the union of multiple dryads.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: Ravnican guild closely aligned with dryads.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: Dryads who act as guildmasters of the Selesnya Conclave.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: Theran god often served by dryads, who often takes a green-skinned dryad-like form.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: Theran god frequently accompanied by dryads.

entities.name: Arasta
entities.description: Dryad and companion of Nylea warped into a monstrous spider by Phenax.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: Bitter god who transformed Arasta into a spider creature.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: His soul traps advanced organic life on Mirrodin, leading to dryads forming from copper trees.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Her arrival made Innistrad's dryads more aggressive.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Ixalan group living in harmony with nature, allied with dryads.

events.summary: Phenax warps the dryad Arasta into a monstrous spider creature.
events.quote: a dryad that was later warped and transformed into a monstrous spider creature by the bitter god Phenax

events.summary: Emrakul's arrival makes Innistrad's dryads more aggressive.
events.quote: With the arrival of Emrakul , many dryads became more aggressive
